annotations.io.stackeroci.stacker.stacker_yaml:
build:
  from:
    type: docker
    url: docker://ghcr.io/project-zot/golang:1.26
  binds:
    - ../. -> /zotcopy
  run: |
    export GO111MODULE=on
    export GOPATH='/go'
    export HOME='/root'
    export PATH='/go/bin:/usr/local/go/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin'
    mkdir -p /go/src/github.com/project-zot
    cd /go/src/github.com/project-zot
    git clone /zotcopy zot
    cd /go/src/github.com/project-zot/zot
    make COMMIT=v2.1.20-3b5796d834e8661ea661a5fcc47add8d4405aebf OS=linux ARCH=amd64 RELEASE_TAG=v2.1.20 clean binary
    cat > config.json << EOF
    {
      "storage":{
          "rootDirectory":"/var/lib/registry"
      },
      "http":{
          "address":"0.0.0.0",
          "port":"5000",
          "compat": ["docker2s2"]
      },
      "log":{
          "level":"debug"
      },
      "extensions": {
        "search": {
            "enable": true,
            "cve": {
                "updateInterval": "2h"
            }
        },
        "ui": {
            "enable": true
        },
        "mgmt": {
          "enable": true
        }
      }
    }
    EOF

    cat config.json
    mkdir -p /zotcopy/.build/zot-linux-amd64
    cd /zotcopy/.build/zot-linux-amd64

    mkdir -p binary/ cert/ config/

    cp /go/src/github.com/project-zot/zot/bin/zot-linux-amd64 binary/
    cp /go/src/github.com/project-zot/zot/config.json config/
    cp /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt cert/
  build_only: true

"zot-linux-amd64":
  annotations:
    org.opencontainers.image.description: "OCI-native container image/artifact registry (purely based on OCI Distribution Specification)"
  os: linux
  arch: amd64
  from:
    type: docker
    url: docker://gcr.io/distroless/base-nossl-debian13:latest-amd64
  overlay_dirs:
    - source: ../.build/zot-linux-amd64/binary
      dest: /usr/local/bin
    - source: ../.build/zot-linux-amd64/cert
      dest: /etc/ssl/certs
    - source: ../.build/zot-linux-amd64/config
      dest: /etc/zot
  entrypoint:
    - /usr/local/bin/zot-linux-amd64
  cmd:
    - serve
    - /etc/zot/config.json
annotations.org.opencontainers.image.description: OCI-native container image/artifact registry (purely based on OCI Distribution Specification)
